description: This file defines a class ConsistencyTestOptions used to configure consistency testing parameters in Orleans, along with an enumeration ReadWriteDetermination that specifies read/write behavior modes.

classes.name: ConsistencyTestOptions
classes.description: A class encapsulating options for consistency testing in Orleans, including seed, number of grains, depth, deadlock and timeout avoidance flags, read/write determination mode, and grain offset. It also defines a maximum grains constant.

methods.name: ConsistencyTestOptions (constructor)
methods.description: Default constructor for initializing ConsistencyTestOptions with default values.
